title: Full Stack Development
skills_required: HTML, SQL, Node.js, C Programming, React, REST API, ORM
description:
1. Build and ship features across the stack - frontend, backend, and database. Actively, not just fixing bugs someone else flagged.

2. Before prompting any AI tool, plan what the function needs to do, what it takes in, what it returns, and where it can break. The prompt is the output of your thinking - not a substitute for it.

3. Use Cursor, Claude, or Codex to execute that plan. Then review every line before it goes anywhere. Accepting and committing is not shipping.

4. Catch what AI gets wrong - and it will get something wrong. If the logic looks right but feels off, dig in. That instinct only exists if you've written and broken enough code yourself.

5. Handle API integration and data flow between services. Boring until it breaks in production, then it's everyone's problem.

6. Pull error logs and debug independently. Form a point of view on what's wrong before escalating.

7. Sit in on architecture and technical decisions with the senior engineer. Absorb. Ask one good question - not five shallow ones.

8. Keep a log of what you built, what broke, and what you learned. Your read, not a status update.

9. Help set up and run test cases - unit, integration, edge cases. Use AI to generate coverage quickly, so you're not bottlenecked.

10. Write documentation specific enough that someone else can pick it up without asking you. If you're not sure it's clear, run it through Claude and ask where it's vague - before it goes to the team.
